english.title: Speeding - use restricted speed vehicle exceeding 50 miles per hour

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[displaying]_
(B)_[displaying a thing resembling]_

the rectangular plate described in Schedule 13 to the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 at a speed exceeding 50 miles per hour.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100A(2)of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use a vehicle on a road
at a speed exceeding 50 mph
when displaying a rectangular plate/thing similar
as described in Sch 13 of the Con and Use Regs

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also H3247 and H3248.
(iii) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence
